title: Unit Event — Happy Enjoy Music! — Episode1 Sparkling Youth!

meta.Event Outline: With their new song released, Leo/need looks forward to Jam Fest. Saki, nervous before her first festival, encounters a familiar face...

rows.Line: Tenma Household - Living Room

rows.Speaker: Saki & Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Leeet's eat!
Let's eat!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hm! The scrambled eggs have a different texture to them today!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, they seem fluffier for some reason.

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line:
Oh, you noticed?
I tried mixing in a little mayonnaise today. That apparently helps make them a bit fluffier.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
So that's what it is!
These are great! They're so fluffy and full of flavor♪

rows.Speaker: Commercial
rows.Line: <This Moment With You!>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Commercial
rows.Line: <Lemonade-flavored FizzYum Cider is only available for a limited time! Let's go out there and enjoy our youth together!>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh, Saki, it's your band's song!

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: I don't think I'm ever going to get tired of this one.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hehe♪
We have to thank Ichi for putting so much effort into it!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: It really is a beautiful expression of youth, isn't it?!

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: Hehe. Yes, it is. Also...

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: I couldn't be happier about your band's song being used for this commercial. You've been watching this company's ads since you were little.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Mom...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, this is indeed a momentous occasion.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
You're back in school, just like in this commercial, having fun and enjoying your youth....
*Sob*

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: S-Stop it, Tsukasa! Don't cry!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Still, hearing our song on TV really does make it feel like we're pros now.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. We need to do our best at Jam Fest, too!

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: Speaking of which, Saki, do you have practice today?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, that's right! Today we're meeting with our company, then having practice until the evening.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I probably won't be home until really late, so go ahead and have dinner without me.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Alright, good luck!
We'll be cheering you on, Saki!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Thanks!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Whoa, look at the time!
I'm gonna be late if I don't go now!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Saki! You'll choke if you scarf down your food like that! You should take smaller bites and chew carefully!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Thanks for breakfast!
Gotta go!

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: Okay, stay safe.
bgm_area00001
School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
...is what happened!
My mom and Tsukasa got all teary-eyed on me earlier this morning!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. They never change.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It's the same over at my house. Every time that commercial comes on, Shizuku locks right onto my face...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: My dad also keeps shouting, “It's Ichika's song!”

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: They really can't contain their excitement.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. Yes, but I suppose that's only natural for your families to feel that way. They've been supporting you all this time.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: They're likely happier than anyone to see you girls going pro together.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, I guess.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Then, that means we gotta make the most of their support by doing well at Jam Fest.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Agreed. Especially since it's going to be our first show since going pro. I'm sure that many of our most loyal fans will be there as well.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah, I definitely want to put on a good show for them.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: While we're on the subject, what's Jam Fest actually supposed to be like? We know that it's one of those events where lots of different bands perform...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Umm... Jam Fest is similar to most other music festivals. There's going to be several big stages where bands will be performing simultaneously.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: This event will have three stages.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: The most famous bands will be performing on the main stage, up-and-coming bands on the sub stage...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: And the one we'll be playing at is the rookie stage, which is for bands that have just debuted.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: The guests are free to move between those three stages and see whichever bands they like.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, having so many stages to choose from sounds like a lot of fun!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: It sounds like people from all walks of life will be attending...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Yes, that's usually the case.
But most will be there to watch the main stage, so I'm not sure how many will be interested in seeing us.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: However, I did hear that STANDOUT and anemone will also be performing on the rookie stage.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: So we'll need to put on a good performance. Can't let them show us up.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I agree. Which means we need to get in a good practice today!

rows.Speaker: Ichika, Saki & Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah!
